resources.string: Interactive collection of Android Splash Screen patterns for students
Logo scale animation (5s), manual Continue button, and automatic timer (7s).
Simulates background tasks (network check, configs, assets) with progress bar.
Carousel of feature cards (ViewPager2) with dots indicator, Skip, and Get Started buttons.
Learn about modern Android navigation patterns and splash design strategies.
Test different user experiences and transitions right in your app.
Apply best practices to your own student Android projects today!
Interactive splash requiring user action (swipe up or triple-tap logo) to enter.
Swipe UP on logo to enter
Multi-element animation using AnimatorSet (fade, slide in, scale logo elements).
Official Android SplashScreen API integration using window background theme.
Dark screen overlay revealed under finger movements using custom Canvas & PorterDuff.CLEAR.
Move finger to shine flashlight and reveal logo
Logo split into 4 corner pieces flying to center via SpringAnimation. Tap pieces to speed up.
Tap pieces or watch them spring together!
Logo reacts dynamically to physical device tilt using SensorManager accelerometer.
Tilt device left or right to sway logo
Gift box ribbon overlay. Swipe downward on the ribbon to unwrap the app logo.
Swipe DOWN on the ribbon to unwrap
Letter-by-letter typing animation using Handler with intentional typo backspace correction.
Seamless transition zooming into target preview using RenderEffect blur removal (API 31+).
Sleeping pulse animation. Press and hold to awaken the app and accelerate breathing pulse.
Press and hold screen to wake up...
Culinary domain ritual: Pinch or tap multi-touch to salt the dish and reveal app logo.
Pinch or tap with 2 fingers to salt the dish!
Adapts greeting and theme to current hour (Calendar) and battery level (BatteryManager).
Displays a random Shakespeare quote, saving total views and preventing consecutive duplicates via SharedPreferences.
Slider at bottom required to drag to 100% to enter. Snaps back to 0 if released early.
Plays a looping silent video background behind logo and enter button using VideoView / MediaPlayer.
Video file (res/raw/splash_video.mp4) not found. Displaying fallback background animation.
Map View zooming into Beer Sheva coordinates (31.2530° N, 34.7915° E) and dropping a logo pin marker.
Zooming to location: Beer Sheva, Israel...
Loads an animated HTML5 Canvas from assets/splash.html with a @JavascriptInterface bridge triggering native navigation.
Custom SurfaceView with a dedicated background thread rendering 120 particles converging to assemble logo shape.
Prompts "How are you feeling today?" with 4 Material 3 Choice Chips altering theme tint and passing chosen mood via Intent.
Peeked BottomSheet over logo layout. Performs a 3-second Y-translation bounce hint animation if untouched.
Front camera mirror feed using CameraX PreviewView with logo mask overlay and privacy disclaimer.
🔒 Privacy Disclaimer: Camera feed is processed live on-device only and is NEVER stored or uploaded.
Tap camera preview to snap & enter!
Displays CalendarView highlighting today\'s date, calculates daily launch streaks in SharedPreferences, and spins clock hands into logo.
Daily Streak: %1$d Days in a Row! 🔥

The classic student splash pattern featuring a scaling logo animation, a manual Continue button, and an automatic CountDownTimer fallback. It teaches basic Activity navigation, ObjectAnimator scaling, and managing timer lifecycles gracefully.

Simulates background initialization tasks such as checking network connectivity, fetching remote configs, and preparing local database tables. Uses LinearProgressIndicator and Handler delays to teach structured async task feedback, transitioning immediately upon 100% completion.

A feature intro carousel built with ViewPager2, TabLayout dot indicators, and dynamic navigation buttons. Teaches swipeable adapters, onboarding state handling, and providing users immediate value before entering the main app.

Requires explicit user interaction to enter, supporting either a vertical swipe gesture or a triple-tap tap counter on the logo. Teaches GestureDetector fling handling, touch event consumption, and interactive unlock transitions.

A multi-element animation sequence using AnimatorSet to coordinate scaling, sliding, and fading multiple UI components in order. Teaches complex animation timing, interpolators, and polished visual branding transitions.

Integrates the official Android 12+ SplashScreen API (androidx.core:core-splashscreen) using window background themes and setKeepOnScreenCondition. Teaches modern system splash guidelines without creating unnecessary blank frames or delay activities.

Uses a custom View overlay with PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR on a Canvas to erase a black mask under the user\'s finger movements. Teaches custom View drawing, PorterDuff xfermodes, and creating playful, curious user discovery moments.

Logo pieces start scattered across screen corners and fly to the center target via OvershootInterpolator spring physics. Tapping individual pieces accelerates their arrival, teaching multi-view coordinate math and interactive layout animations.

Connects to SensorManager to read accelerometer tilt events, dynamically rotating and swaying the logo in real time as the physical phone moves. Teaches Android sensor listeners, orientation math, and fallback simulation modes for emulators.

Features a gift box ribbon overlay. Listening to a downward fling gesture via GestureDetector, it uses ViewPropertyAnimator to unwrap the ribbon and open the gift box, teaching gesture-driven unboxing rituals.

Sequentially types out title text character-by-character using Handler.postDelayed(), featuring an intentional typo and backspace correction sequence. Teaches string substring manipulation, Handler timing loops, and humanized UI animations.

Renders a blurred and scaled-down preview of the target destination screen using RenderEffect.createBlurEffect (API 31+). Over 2.5 seconds, the camera zooms in smoothly while removing blur, teaching seamless screen transitions and RenderEffect graphics.

Features a sleeping logo pulse powered by ValueAnimator. Holding down on the screen (ACTION_DOWN) brightens the background and accelerates breathing until awake, teaching touch state handling and dynamic animator parameters.

A domain-specific culinary ritual where multi-touch or tap gestures spawn animated salt particles that fall over a dish, gradually revealing the logo. Teaches domain-driven UX design, multi-touch event handling, and particle animations.

Dynamically reads system time (Calendar) to show time-appropriate greetings and themes, while querying BatteryManager to trigger a jitter animation if battery is below 15%. Teaches system environment awareness and context-adaptive UI design.

Selects a random Shakespeare quote from an array on startup, using SharedPreferences to persist total quote views and prevent showing the exact same quote on consecutive launches. Teaches data persistence, key-value storage, and array randomization.

Requires dragging a SeekBar or Slider control to 100% to unlock the application, snapping back to zero if released early. Teaches SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener, live progress tracking, custom slider styling, and touch snap-back logic.

Plays a silent looping video clip in the background using VideoView and MediaPlayer.OnPreparedListener setLooping(true). Teaches media playback lifecycles, raw resource handling, and evaluating performance tradeoffs of heavy video splash assets.

Renders a map layout zooming smoothly into specific coordinates (Beer Sheva, Israel) and dropping a logo location marker pin. Teaches map integration concepts, camera updates, location permissions, and marker animations.

Loads a local HTML5 Canvas animation from assets/splash.html inside a WebView. Uses addJavascriptInterface to bind a Java bridge, allowing JavaScript user clicks or canvas events to trigger native Android Activity navigation.

Features a custom SurfaceView driven by a background render thread (SurfaceHolder.Callback). Animates 120 particle physics objects with velocity and attraction forces converging off the UI thread to form the logo.

Offers a Material 3 ChipGroup single-selection interface ("🚀 Productive", "😌 Calm", "🤔 Learning", "🎮 Relaxed") that alters background theme tint dynamically and passes user persona data via Intent extras for immediate UX personalization.

Employs CoordinatorLayout and BottomSheetBehavior with a peeked sheet over background artwork. Includes a 3-second inactivity timer that triggers a subtle Y-translation bounce hint animation to guide user interaction.

Integrates CameraX PreviewView with front camera binding and an explicit privacy disclosure banner. Teaches CameraX lifecycle binding, CameraSelector.LENS_FACING_FRONT, runtime camera permissions, and privacy best practices.

Features CalendarView with today\'s date highlighted, calculating consecutive daily app launch streaks stored in SharedPreferences. Teaches Calendar date arithmetic, SharedPreferences persistence, and clock rotation animations.
